pkgmetadata.name: KosmiK2001
pkgmetadata.description: Fusion Icon 2 - system tray for switching Compiz window managers. Supports Compiz, Marco, Metacity with Emerald/GTK decorators. Includes NVIDIA Force Composition Pipeline options.
pkgmetadata.longdescription:
[EN] Fusion Icon 2 is a GTK3 system tray utility for switching between Compiz, Marco, and Metacity window managers. Features include window decorator selection (Emerald, GTK Window Decorator), Compiz Options (Indirect Rendering, Loose Binding), NVIDIA Options (Force Composition Pipeline, Force Full Composition Pipeline), auto-detection of current WM/decorator, persistent settings via config file or GSettings, and debug mode with GPU/driver information.
[RU] Fusion Icon 2 — GTK3 системный трей для переключения между оконными менеджерами Compiz, Marco и Metacity. Возможности: выбор декоратора окон (Emerald, GTK Window Decorator), Compiz Options (Indirect Rendering, Loose Binding), NVIDIA Options (Force Composition Pipeline, Force Full Composition Pipeline), авто-определение текущего WM/декоратора, сохранение настроек в конфиг-файле или GSettings, debug режим с информацией о GPU/драйвере.

use.flag: Store settings in a plain text config file (~/.config/fusion-icon2/config). This is the default backend.
Store settings using GSettings/dconf instead of a plain file. Provides integration with GNOME/MATE desktop settings. Mutually exclusive with the file USE flag.
Compress the binary with UPX for smaller size.
